translations.web: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.
translations.bsb: Resist him, standing firm in your faith and in the knowledge that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kinds of suffering.
translations.kjv: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
